description: This file contains utility methods for processing and manipulating the Mini-language within the OFBiz framework, including script detection, method invocation, type conversion, XML document corrections, and file writing.

classes.name: MiniLangUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for Mini-language processing, including script detection, method invocation, type conversions, document correction flags, and XML serialization.

classes.name: MiniLangUtil.PlainString
classes.description: A placeholder class used for representing string objects in conversions.

methods.name: containsScript
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains any script prefix defined in SCRIPT_PREFIXES.

methods.name: autoCorrectOn
methods.description: Determines if auto-correction of the Mini-language scripts is enabled based on properties configuration.

methods.name: callMethod
methods.description: Invokes a specified method on a given object with provided parameters, handling reflection and exceptions.

methods.name: convertType
methods.description: Converts an object to a specified target class, with support for locale, timezone, and formatting options.

methods.name: flagDocumentAsCorrected
methods.description: Marks an XML Document as having been auto-corrected.

methods.name: getObjectClassForConversion
methods.description: Returns an appropriate class for conversion purposes based on the object's type.

methods.name: isConstantAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a string attribute value is a constant expression.

methods.name: isConstantPlusExpressionAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an attribute value is a constant or a constant combined with an expression.

methods.name: isDocumentAutoCorrected
methods.description: Determines whether an XML Document has been marked as auto-corrected.

methods.name: writeMiniLangDocument
methods.description: Transforms and writes an XML Document to a specified URL using a style sheet.
